news.title: VIDEO: Anonymous tip leads police to wanted man, stash of drugs at Atlanta hotel
news.summary: A wanted man was arrested at a midtown Atlanta hotel after police say they found a gun and multiple illegal drugs inside his room.

news.title: Gwinnett County mom charged in son's hot car death in can attend funeral
news.summary: A judge will allow Deja Coleman, the Gwinnett County mother charged with second-degree murder in her 1-year-old son's hot car death, to attend his funeral Saturday.

news.title: 2 charged after dog stolen outside metro Atlanta gas station
news.summary: A beloved dog is back home with his owner after police say two suspects stole the pet from a vehicle parked at a gas station Thursday night.

news.title: Smyrna Police identify suspect seen in pistol-whipping road rage incident caught on video
news.summary: Police say a man was "pummeled with a handgun" in a fight on June 27. A suspect has now been identified.

news.title: Son arrested for killing 65-year-old father in DeKalb County
news.summary: DeKalb County police have identified the man found dead outside a home Friday morning as 65-year-old Jerome Wyatt.

news.title: Son charged with father’s murder at DeKalb County home near elementary school
news.summary: Police said a man has been arrested in connection with the shooting death of his 65-year-old father at a home Friday.

news.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta star accused of swindling victims out of nearly $200K
news.summary: A former reality television personality is facing multiple felony charges after investigators say she played a role in a real estate fraud scheme that cost victims nearly $200,000.

news.title: ‘Love & Hip Hop’ star 'Betty Idol' arrested, accused of $200K real estate scam
news.summary: Reality TV star Salomes Jackson ("Betty Idol"), known for her appearances on Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta, was arrested in Volusia County for her alleged role in a $196,000 real estate scam.

news.title: Sandy Springs massage employee arrested for sexual battery, police seeking additional victims
news.summary: Now, investigators are asking anyone who has received services from this man and believes they may have experienced inappropriate or unwanted contact.
